Viper's Bite
60 Focus
Instant20 sec cooldown
Requires Melee Weapon
Generates 2 Advantage
Unleash 4 quick strikes over 1 sec to an enemy, each dealing 85% Weapon Damage.

If the target is bleeding, each strike deals an additional 400+3.2 Points Per Level+AP*.25 Physical damage.

If the target is poisoned, each strike deals Nature damage instead of Physical damage.
